description: What rigs accept beyond their actions' signatures: the values the fluent builder's methods take.

easing.description: How a change paces itself over its time.

oneOf.description: The same pace start to end.
Starts slow and speeds up, on a sine curve.
Starts fast and slows into the end, on a sine curve.
Slow at both ends, fastest in the middle, on a sine curve.
ease_in, sharper: a squared curve.
ease_out, sharper: a squared curve.
ease_in_out, sharper: a squared curve.
ease_in, sharper again: a cubed curve.
ease_out, sharper again: a cubed curve.
ease_in_out, sharper again: a cubed curve.
ease_in at its sharpest: a fourth-power curve.
ease_out at its sharpest: a fourth-power curve.
ease_in_out at its sharpest: a fourth-power curve.

interpolation.description: How a direction or vector gets from one value to the other.

oneOf.description: Blends the two directions and keeps the result a direction; a vector's speed blends separately. Quickest through the middle of a turn.
Turns at an even rate through the angle between the two directions. Directions only: a vector treats it as lerp.
Blends x and y each on their own, with no normalizing: for reversals, where the direction passes through zero.

mode.description: What a layer does to the value coming into it.

oneOf.description: Adds to the incoming value.
Replaces the incoming value.
Multiplies the incoming value.

behavior.description: What happens when a change fires again while the last one is still running. 'to' replaces by default; the rest stack.

oneOf.description: Adds another instance on top. stack(max) caps how many.
Cancels the running instance and starts again.
Waits for the running instance to finish, then runs.
throttle(ms) ignores fires again within ms. Bare throttle() ignores them while the last one is still running.
debounce(ms) runs once fires have stopped for ms. The ms is needed.
